The leaf shows whitish-grey powdery patches scattered across the upper surface, with no sunken brown lesions (ruling out Anthracnose), no black sooty encrustations (ruling out Sooty Mould), and no gum/bark symptoms (ruling out Die_Back). The diffuse, pale grey-white coating distributed across the leaf surface is characteristic of powdery mildew infection.
